string.name: text
string.value: You were assigned to find Luminous, so you headed for the Forest Edge around Ellinia to search for him.

string.name: text
string.value: You stumbled upon a robot, which seemed out of place. It called you an intruder, so you fought it, thinking it had to be evil.

string.name: text
string.value: Luminous, the Magician of Light, showed up just as you defeated the robot, which turned out not to be an enemy after all.

string.name: text
string.value: After you calmed him down, Luminous revealed that Seal Stones were created to seal the Black Mage away, but that this method wouldn't work a second time. He couldn't help you further.

string.name: text
string.value: You parted with Luminous to return to Maple Island.

string.name: text
string.value: When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:
